description: IIT Madras partners with FaMe TN to accelerate AI-led Digital Transformation for MSMEs in Tamil Nadu
body_lead: IIT Madras partners with FaMe TN to accelerate AI-led Digital Transformation for MSMEs in Tamil Nadu - 29th Jul 2026 - Press Release Indian Institute of Technology Madras (IIT Madras) has partnered with the Bureau for Facilitating MSMEs of Tamil Nadu (FaMe TN), a State Government agency to support micro, small and medium enterprises (MSME), to accelerate digital transformation, Artificial Intelligence (AI) adoption and capability building across the State’s MSMEs ecosystem.
